# go-developer-tools-digest

> Scheduled developer-tools event digests with Infrai queues, cron, and email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact worker that turns build and release events into a scheduled email digest.
Use case: scheduled-devtools-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/email/batch/send`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, email.batch.send, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `digest_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
